This is more than a senior HR leadership role. It is an opportunity to operate at the heart of the business, partner with senior leaders, build organisational capability and create the best place to work conditions for our people and for our business to thrive. As a key member of the sub-regional leadership team, you will act as a trusted strategic advisor and thought partner, bringing commercial insight, people expertise and constructive challenge to business decisions. Your mandate will span business partnering, organisational effectiveness, talent and succession, leadership capability, culture and engagement, transformation, HR governance and the delivery of high-quality people processes across the sub-region. You will lead and develop Country Heads of HR, create alignment across the cluster and ensure that HR delivers meaningful value to the business and its people. What you will lead Shape and execute the people strategy for West and Central Africa, aligned with Regional and business priorities. Advise and challenge the Sub-Regional Director and leadership team on strategic people, leadership and organisational matters. Lead organisational design, workforce planning and transformation initiatives that enable sustainable business performance. Strengthen the leadership pipeline, succession bench and organisational capability across the sub-region. Build a high-performance culture grounded in engagement, inclusion, accountability and DHL’s values. Lead, coach and develop Country Heads of HR and strengthen HR capability across the cluster. Ensure consistent delivery of HR services across talent acquisition, reward, talent management, learning and development, employee relations and HR operations. Anticipate and manage people, organisational and employment-related risks across multiple jurisdictions. Maintain strong governance across payroll, compensation, recruitment, employee data and HR reporting. Partner with Regional HR functional leaders to ensure effective implementation of corporate, global and regional priorities. Use people insights, business data and external market intelligence to support informed leadership decisions. What you will bring A relevant university degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resources, Business, Industrial Psychology or a related field. Substantial senior HR leadership experience, preferably within a multinational, multi-country or emerging-market environment. A strong track record of operating as a strategic partner to executive and senior business leaders. Broad HR expertise across organisational effectiveness, talent, reward, employee relations, workforce planning and change. Demonstrated experience leading senior HR professionals and building effective HR teams. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate business strategy into practical people priorities. Experience navigating complex employment, cultural and regulatory environments. High levels of judgement, resilience, integrity and personal credibility. Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder-management capability. Fluency in English, with professional proficiency in French strongly preferred. Willingness to be based in Cameroon, Côte d’Ivoire or Senegal and to travel regularly. Why DHL Express? We Deliver the Difference Join a business whose purpose extends beyond logistics. Your leadership will help connect people and businesses, facilitate trade and support economic growth across West and Central Africa. We Care Lead in a culture grounded in respect, trust and safety, where Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging are integral to how we work. We Grow Together Take on a highly visible regional leadership role within a global organisation that provides meaningful opportunities to grow, develop and build a career across countries, functions and businesses. Ready to make an impact? If you are a strategic, commercially minded and people-focused HR leader with the ability to influence at the highest levels and lead effectively across countries and cultures, we would like to hear from you. DHL Express. Connecting people. Improving lives.

This role will create meaningful learning experiences that support employees throughout their journey—from onboarding and role mastery to leadership development and career advancement. VisionSpring’s existing development philosophy emphasizes stretch assignments, job shadowing, mentoring, coaching, role expansion, and structured career pathways. This position reports to the Global Vice President People & Culture based in the United States. You possess: Deep expertise in adult learning theory, instructional design, and experiential learning methodologies. A demonstrated ability to design competency-based learning journeys that shorten time-to-competency and improve individual performance. Experience creating curriculum architectures, learning pathways, and capability frameworks for employees at different levels and career stages. A strong understanding of how learning connects to talent development, performance management, retention, engagement, internal mobility, and succession planning. Experience designing leadership development, manager effectiveness, mentorship, coaching, and career development programs. Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple global initiatives across cultures, geographies, and matrixed environments. Strong facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences in both virtual and in-person settings. Excellent analytical skills and experience measuring learning effectiveness, capability growth, and training impact. Outstanding interpersonal skills and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. A customer-focused mindset and the ability to build strong relationships across functions and regions. High levels of discretion, professionalism, and integrity when handling confidential information. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and learning technologies, including Learning Management Systems (LMS). About Us VisionSpring increases lifelong earning, learning, safety, and well-being through eyeglasses for people vulnerable to poverty. We believe in the wonder of clear vision for everybody. We sell and deliver radically affordable optical products and services and develop markets for eyeglasses—a 700-year-old technology that has failed to reach 1 billion people in need of vision correction, most of whom live on less than $4 a day. We serve low-income consumers, not as beneficiaries but as customers. Our customers expect quality, affordable products and eyecare services, and will spend limited discretionary income for the immediate and tangible benefits of vision correction. As a social enterprise, we are purpose first. We blend philanthropic and earned revenue, draw on non-profit and business practices, and use sales and efficiency metrics and social impact measures to bring vision correction to ever more people. We catalyze collaborative action in an expansive, multisector partner network and use our evidence and experience to influence systems change and close the global clear vision gap. We believe in scaling our impact, not our organization. We are a lean team of doers. Our big goal: Everyone who needs eyeglasses will have them by 2050. Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with cross-functional global teams, both internal and external Experience building and facilitating virtual, classroom, and blended learning experiences. Experience managing global projects within a matrixed organization. Experience administering or utilizing Learning Management Systems (LMS). Strong background in learning evaluation, measurement, and analytics. Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of development initiatives. Experience supporting culturally diverse and geographically dispersed teams. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Adult Learning, Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology, Education, or a related field preferred. Fluent English speaker with exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in an NGO, social enterprise, international development, healthcare, education, or mission-driven organization. Experience building leadership development, coaching, and mentorship programs. Experience creating competency frameworks and career architecture models. Experience supporting employees across Africa, South Asia, and global matrixed environments. Strengthen internal talent pipelines and succession readiness. Increase employee perception of growth and career opportunities. Demonstrate measurable business impact from learning investments. Partner with leaders to identify organizational capability gaps and future workforce needs. Create competency frameworks and development pathways aligned with business priorities and organizational growth. Serve as the strategic owner of VisionSpring Academy and its learning portfolio. Curriculum Design & Learning Architecture Design and develop engaging learning curricula for employees, managers, leaders, and functional teams. Create structured learning journeys that combine classroom learning, virtual learning, e-learning, coaching, mentoring, peer learning, stretch assignments, and experiential projects. Measure learning effectiveness through multi-level evaluation methodologies. Track and report on key metrics such as: Learning participation Competency attainment Time-to-competency Internal mobility Leadership readiness Learning application and impact Use data and insights to improve learning programs and investments continuously. Facilitation & Program Delivery Facilitate leadership, management, professional development, and culture-building programs globally. Support the expansion of digital, virtual, and blended learning experiences. Contribute innovative learning approaches that enhance engagement and knowledge transfer. Special Projects Lead and support strategic People & Culture initiatives related to organizational effectiveness, talent development, and employee growth.
